effects.stat_block_md:
___
> ## Utility Drone
> *Tiny Construct (Drone) (CR 1/4)*
> ___
> - **Armor Class** 13 (natural armor)
> - **Hit Points** 6 (2d4 + 1; bloodied 3)
> - **Speed** 30 ft., or fly 30 ft. (hover), swim 30 ft.
> ___
> |STR|DEX|CON|INT|WIS|CHA|
> |:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
> |4 (-4)|16 (+3)|13 (+1)|1 (-5)|10 (+0)|1 (-5)|
> ___
> - **Proficiency** +2; Maneuver DC 13
> - **Senses** blindsight 10 ft., passive Perception 12
> - **Damage Immunities** poison, psychic
> - **Condition Immunities** charmed, fatigue, frightened,
> - **Languages** Common, Machine
> ___
> 50 XP paralyzed, petrified, poisoned
>
> ***Malfunction.*** The drone malfunctions when it takes a critical hit, becoming confused until another creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Engineering check to end the condition.
>
> ***Recording.*** The drone can stream audio-visual data to its control device or to other adjacent devices. Its on-board memory can record up to 1 hour of footage. No action is required for the drone to begin streaming or recording.
>
> ***Special Delivery.*** The drone can hold an object or objects weighing no more than 5 pounds. Adjacent allied creatures can retrieve these items as a bonus action.
>
> ### Actions
> ***Spark.*** Melee Weapon Attack: +5 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 3) lightning damage. Combat If it cannot run or has been programmed to fight, the utility drone chooses a target (preferably one not targeted by one of its fellow drones) and attacks until that target is neutralized. It fights to the death. Variants: Modified Utility Drones Some drones have been loaded with weapons or equipment that changes their capabilities. The following are varieties of utility drone: Counselor Drone This drone is designed to provide information. Some are stationed in one location in a 'help desk' role, while others accompany individual people. The drone's Intelligence is treated as 16 (+3) for the purposes of recalling information only. It has proficiency in History, Science, and Culture, making those checks with a +5 bonus. Hacker Drone The drone gains the following trait and additional action:
>
> ***Built-in Hacker.*** The drone has integrated hacking tools which it uses with a +4 bonus; its Intelligence is treated as 14 (+2) for the purposes of hacking only. It can attempt to hack an adjacent device and is able to perform hacking maneuvers.
>
> ***Hacking Accomplice.*** Creatures directly controlling this drone can hack devices adjacent to it as if they'd established a direct connection. Healer Drone The drone gains the following additional action:
>
> ***Heal.*** The drone lands on a creature and injects it with nanobots that heal it for 11 (3d4+4) hit points. The drone can only hold 3 uses of the nanobots at a time. Refills cost 100 credits per nanobot pouch. Recon Drone The drone gains the following trait:
>
> ***Sight Expertise.*** The recon drone has proficiency in Perception, and its Wisdom score is treated as though it were 16 (+3) for the purposes of perception only. It has a +5 bonus to Perception and a passive Perception of 15. The drone is able to record and stream up to 24 hours of audiovisual data (instead of 1 hour). In addition, the drone gains darkvision to a range of 120 feet. Exterminator Drone These deadly drones are intelligent and filled with hate. Larger than most, they are heavily armed and want nothing more than the destruction of all life in the universe.

>
> ***Communicator.*** The drone can silently communicate with drones and devices of its choice that are within 1 mile of it.
>
> ***Loudspeaker.*** The drone can make its voice heard up to 300 feet away.
>
> ***Malfunction.*** The drone malfunctions when it takes a critical hit, becoming confused until another creature within 5 feet makes a DC 10 Engineering check to end the condition.
>
> ### Actions
> ***Multiattack.*** The drone attacks twice with its blaster.
>
> ***Blaster.*** Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 60/120 ft. one target. Hit: 6 (1d8 + 2) force damage. Combat The drone chooses a target (preferably one not targeted by one of its fellow drones) and attacks until that target is neutralized. It fights to the death. Variants: Modified Drones Some drones have been loaded with weapons or equipment that changes their capabilities. The following are varieties of drone: Assassin Drone
>
> ***The drone's CR is 4.*** It has 60 hit points and its
>
> ***Sniper.*** Ranged Weapon Attack: +6 to hit, range 120 ft., one target. Hit: 18 (4d8) radiant damage. Bomber Drone This drone is essentially a flying bomb, designed to explode when it reaches its target. It has 32 hit points. The drone's CR is 3. It replaces its Blaster action with the following action:
>
> ***Detonate.*** The drone explodes in a 20 foot radius area. Each creature in the area makes a DC 14 Dexterity saving throw, taking 26 (4d12) fire damage on a failure or half damage on a success. Flamethrower Drone
>
> ***The drone's CR is 2.*** It gains the following additional action:
>
> ***Flamethrower.*** The drone spouts flame in a 15 foot cone. Each creature in the area makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage on a failure or half damage on a success. Mortar Drone
>
> ***The drone's CR is 2.*** It gains the following additional action:
>
> ***Mortar.*** The drone fires a bomb to a point within 120 feet that it can see. The bomb then falls until it hits a liquid or solid surface where it detonates in a 20 foot radius explosion. Each creature in the area makes a DC 12 Dexterity saving throw, taking 14 (4d6) fire damage and falling prone on a failure or taking half damage and not falling prone on a success. Processor Drone The drone's Intelligence is 14 (+2) and its CR is 2. It gains the following bonus action:
>
> ***Service Ticket.*** As a bonus action, the drone can issue an order to another drone within 30 feet. The other drone can use a reaction to make an attack. Shield Drone
>
> ***The drone's CR is 2.*** The drone's passive Perception becomes 15 and its Perception skill becomes +5. It also gains blindsight 60 ft.
>
> ***Shield Generator (Recharge 6).*** The drone and creatures of its choice within 5 feet of it gain 10 temporary hit points. Stunner Drone The drone replaces its Blaster action with the following action:
>
> ***Arc Stunner.*** Ranged Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, range 20 ft., one target. Hit: 9 (2d6 + 2) lightning damage. If this damage makes a creature bloodied it makes a DC 12 Wisdom saving throw or falls asleep for 1 minute, until it takes damage, or someone uses an action to shake or slap the creature awake. Utility Drone The smallest drones typically serve a specific purpose, a utility that takes up all or most of their capacity to accomplish. These simple drones are typically assistants, messengers, or scouts. Utility drones either fly or move on the ground.
